title: Ghana and UK sign agreements on cybercrime and fraud cooperation, Ghana High Commission says
date_note: The High Street Journal gives only its own publication day, 25 November; the page states no signing date.
summary: The High Street Journal reports that Ghana and the UK signed Memoranda of Understanding to strengthen security cooperation on cybercrime, fraud and emerging cross-border threats. The Ghana High Commission in the UK announced the agreements, saying they "pave the way for deeper operational cooperation in tackling cybercrime and fraud." The article does not name the signatories or give a signing date.
plain: Ghana and the UK have signed agreements to work together against cybercrime and fraud, according to the Ghana High Commission in the UK as reported by The High Street Journal.
exec: Ghana and the UK signed cooperation agreements on cybercrime and fraud, the Ghana High Commission says, as reported by one Ghanaian outlet.
geo_basis: Bilateral agreement announced by Ghana's High Commission; no city stated, Ghana's capital used
org: Ghana High Commission in the UK

validation.note: Only The High Street Journal read; it relays the Ghana High Commission announcement.
